static_traits.family_status: Lives with mother；与Mother关系亲密，她是重要支持者
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；既往not yet接受心理治疗；过去not yet出现类似问题

basic_info.main_problem: 因上周读书会迟到而产生“我not负责任、我很懒”的自我贴标签，这一模式在遇到小失误时频繁出现，削弱自尊并影响日常生活。
basic_info.core_demands: 希望在专业指导下识do not并改变对小失误的自我贴标签与个人化模式，改善自尊与心理健康。

core_beliefs: 我是懒惰且not负责任的人

special_situations.event: 上周参加读书会时迟到
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我出现一次失误，就说明我是懒惰且not负责任的人
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 通过自我Reflection与积极自我对话来纠正错误

special_situations.event: 在工作中忘记发送一封邮件
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我忘记一个任务，do not人会认为我not在乎，我是not可靠的人
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 尝试保持忙碌，并进行自我Reflection和积极自我对话以弥补失误

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能完全按时完成所有事情，就说明我是not可靠的人
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 保持忙碌以避免再次失误

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我have not把每件小事都做对，就意味着我很懒惰
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 自我批评后尝试以积极自我对话安抚自己

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被视为负责任、可靠并得到他人认可
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被看作懒惰与not可靠，从而被negate
defense_goal: Through harsh self-criticism and self-labeling, monitors and constrains themselves to reduce mistakes and maintain a sense of safety

object_relations.self_representation: 懒惰、not可靠、容易犯错的自责者
object_relations.object_representation: 他人是会批评我、认为我not在乎的评判者

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: In counseling, when talking about small mistakes made (such as being late, forgetting to send an email)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为他人会把自己视为not在乎、懒惰的人（移情：将外界可能的负面评价内化并Projection到咨询师/他人）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以自责性的语气描述事件，重复“我很懒/not负责任”，减少对外情境的探讨，强调自身过错。

manifestations: 对“负责任/懒惰”的强烈自我评判，将守时与not犯错视为自我价值的核心
在小失误后体验到羞愧与Self-denial，担心他人看法

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: 将“必须时刻负责任、not能迟到或犯错”视为绝对标准
在小失误后用“我not负责任”等标签评价自己

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on.
manifestations: 频繁自责与Self-denial，过度关注他人如何看待自己
面对小失误过度谨慎，Decreased drive

positive_force: 与Mother关系亲密，获得稳定的情感支持
Willing to proactively seek professional help and cooperate with recording and goal setting
具备自我Reflection与意识到认知模式的能力
有工作与兴趣爱好维持日常节律
negative_force: Overgeneralization and personalization of small mistakes, tending toward self-labeling
过度在意他人评价，出现读心与心理过滤
Impaired self-esteem导致Decreased drive与日常效率降低
对“完美守时/not犯错”的僵化标准

target_behavior.behavior: 在发生小失误后进行自我贴标签与严苛自责，并出现Low mood与Decreased drive
target_behavior.core_reason: 将一次失误泛化为整体人格问题（“懒惰/not负责任”），并担心他人负面评价
target_behavior.function: 试图通过自我批评来ReinforcementSelf-monitoring与避免再次犯错（负Reinforcement），同时回避面对错误的not确定与他人评价
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased self-esteem、Low mood、Insufficient motivation，影响日常工作与生活
